name: herdr-toolkit
description: Operating skills for running Claude Code on top of the Herdr agent multiplexer — delegate implementation work to a cross-vendor CLI agent (Codex etc.) with a fabrication-resistant acceptance discipline, and spawn detached Remote Control sessions for other projects from your phone. The herdr CLI skill itself is not bundled: Herdr installs it as part of its own Claude Code integration. The always-loaded delegation-gate rule is not part of the plugin; copy it into your rules directory separately.
